指数是本站的比较模型，不是游戏内评分或制作成功率。同一阶段、同一品质、同类有效候: Scores are this site's comparison model, not in-game ratings or success chances. Metrics are converted to relative scores from 0 to 100 among comparable items at the same stage and quality, then weighted below. Ties receive the same score; searching and sorting do not change the baseline.
整包饱食 = 每次饱食 × UseTimes；每 100 饱食成本 = 整包配置: Pack satiety = satiety per use × UseTimes. Cost per 100 satiety = base pack price ÷ pack satiety × 100. Base prices are configuration values; check availability and actual shop prices in the game.
每锅食材摊销价 = Σ（整包基价 ÷ 使用次数 × 配方用量）。从零整包购买价会: Ingredient cost per pot = Σ(pack price ÷ uses × recipe amount). Buying from scratch rounds up to whole packs, leaving unused portions. Facility, fuel, water, action and acquisition costs are excluded, as are character bonuses, satiety overflow and extra triggered effects.
固定配方整锅恢复按成品五项配置分别向上取整；可吃次数沿用已核对的分份规则，每次恢: Fixed-recipe totals round up each of the five configured stats. Uses follow the verified serving rule; effects per use = pot total ÷ uses. A pot produces one item with multiple uses, so uses must not multiply the pot total again.
Satiety gain = pot satiety − raw ingredient satiety. Supporting recovery = mood + 0.5 × energy + health + 0.5 × life, including negatives. Penalty = min(30, 100 × weighted negative effects ÷ max(1, total satiety)); negative weights are 2, 1, 3 and 2 respectively.
前、中、后期分别按 MinLevel ≤ 1、2、3 纳入配方；等级是制作条件，: Early, mid and late stages include recipes with MinLevel ≤ 1, 2 and 3. Levels are requirements; selected quality is a comparison scenario, not a guaranteed result. Generic recipes depend on full ingredient combinations, tiers and specific-recipe priority, so they remain unrated combination candidates.
作物按 Gain 中重复 ID 计普通基础收获数量，再乘物品 UseTimes。: Normal harvest quantities count repeated IDs in Gain and multiply by UseTimes. Raw satiety and cooking uses are alternative uses, not additive yields. GrowthTime ÷ 86400 gives base growing days, normalized by configured Size. Perfect harvests, returned seeds, facility and planting-level bonuses are excluded; unlimited repeat harvests are not assumed.
保质比较直接使用配置 Life 的正值，不为其编造单位或冷藏后的期限；无效价格、: Shelf-life comparisons use positive configured Life values without inferring units or refrigerated durations. Invalid prices, unknown uses, missing stats and non-food crops are unrated; zero prices do not imply free purchases. Recipe coverage counts calculable fixed recipes, without assuming other ingredients are available. Zero benefit receives zero relative score for nonnegative metrics.

先看是否命中指定食材的专用配方，再看分类组合。通用配方取参与食材中的最高档，主食: Specific ingredient recipes take priority over category combinations. Generic recipes use the highest contributing ingredient tier; staples do not contribute. Other ingredients can have lower tiers. Product quality is a separate condition that affects recovery.
花椰菜价格 30，达到蔬菜高档阈值 30；小家鼠与白玉菇是低档。因此，小家鼠 +: Cauliflower costs 30, exactly the high-tier vegetable threshold. House Mouse and White Beech Mushroom are low tier, but this combination still produces the high-tier dish. Replacing the ingredient that sets the tier can change the dish name.
价格按整件配置基价判断档位，不按单次用量价格或实际交易价格。通用菜肴的饱腹、健康: Ingredient tier uses the configured whole-item base price, rather than the price per cooking use or the actual trade price. Generic recipe satiety, health and life depend on ingredients; morale and energy use the selected quality's product configuration.
低于中档阈值为低档；价格恰好等于阈值也算达到。没有列出的分类不参与档位计算。技能: Prices below the mid-tier threshold are low tier. Equality meets a threshold. Unlisted categories do not contribute to tier. Skills and statuses can set a minimum tier; cooking level filters recipes. Select these separately.
通用配方：总饱腹 = 向上取整（食材饱腹合计 × 档位系数 × 品质系数 + 食: Generic recipes: total satiety = ceil(sum of ingredient satiety × tier coefficient × quality coefficient + ingredient uses × 2). Health and life use the same coefficients without the base bonus. Morale and energy use the selected quality's configured product values, rounded up. Special recipes use product configuration for all five stats.
Tier coefficients: high 1.7 / mid 1.4 / low 1.1. Quality coefficients: failed 0.5 / normal 0.9 / good 1.2 / perfect 1.5. Calculations use the game's float32 arithmetic before rounding. Stats per use = total stats ÷ number of servings.

指定配方优先；通用配方按实际食材、最高档位和所选品质计算。通用菜心态、精力取品质: Specific recipes take priority. Generic recipes use actual ingredients, their highest contributing tier and the chosen quality. 收益按每日饱食、心态目标归一化；负担按每日预算、照料分钟、可用种植容量和等待容忍: Benefits are normalized to daily satiety and morale targets; burdens to cost, care time, capacity and acceptable wait. Efficiency is benefit divided by one plus weighted burden, converted to a tie-aware percentile among comparable candidates. Negative recovery deducts up to 30 points. Search and sorting do not change the scoring pool.

Benefits are normalized to daily satiety and morale targets; burdens to cost, care time, capacity and acceptable wait. Efficiency is benefit divided by one plus weighted burden, converted to a tie-aware percentile among comparable candidates. Negative recovery deducts up to 30 points. Long-term supply uses base morale recovery; today's settlement excludes gains above your current cap. Search and sorting do not change the scoring pool.
每次食材购买价 = 整包 price ÷ UseTimes；每次交易换入基值 =: Purchase cost per use = whole-item price / UseTimes; trade-in base value per use = TradeValue. These units stay separate. Growing includes new seed costs without assuming free returned seeds. Fertilizer, electricity, fuel, travel and equipment purchases are excluded.
按所选容器种满计算：种子数 = floor(容量 ÷ 作物尺寸)。生长时间按设施: Calculations fill the selected container: seeds = floor(capacity / plant size). Growth is shortened by multiplicative facility, skill and additional speed factors. Normal and perfect harvests are separate scenarios, without assumed success rates or unlimited regrowth. Special greenhouse fertilizing and regrowth crops are excluded from basic rankings.
基础播种 15 分钟、收获 5 分钟；除虫、除草、浇水各 5 分钟。生长期每个容: Base sowing takes 15 minutes, harvest 5, and each pest, weed or watering action 5. Each growing container checks daily. Probability = max(0, plant base + facility adjustment) × max(0, 1 - skill reduction); all three are normalized together if their sum exceeds 1. This estimates prompt treatment; randomness, delays and rain change actual time.
短周期增加每日播种和收获次数；不只按产量排名。每日方案按整数食用次数满足饱食需求: Short cycles increase daily sowing and harvesting, so rankings consider more than yield. Whole servings meet daily satiety needs, with morale shortfalls, excess satiety, average pots and budgets shown. Containers round up; shared harvests do not duplicate space. Daily care and seeds cover all allocated containers without credit for surplus. Capacity means internal planting space; arrange actual furniture floor space in-game.
基础心态结算 = max(0, floor((结算前心态 − 50) ÷ 5)): Base morale settlement = max(0, floor((morale before settlement - 50) / 5)), and exchanged morale is deducted. Enter morale without these meals and your cap to compare the difference. The cap is included; other daily events are excluded. Enter a different conversion step if talents change it.
每锅交出估值 = 品质成品 TradeValue × 实际分份次数。商人折价情景: Trade-out estimate per pot = quality product TradeValue × actual servings. The merchant scenario applies positive TradeSellRate below 1; unadjusted base values use no discount. Net value subtracts ingredient trade-in base values. It is neither cash profit nor a guaranteed deal; demand, appraisal, affinity, discounts, stock and trade channels affect transactions.

“该据点当前想要什么”的需求轮换、来往好感与关系等级、鉴价加成、谈判折扣、货架受: Demand rotation, bond and relation tiers, appraisal bonus, negotiation discounts, shelf damage and stock levels are runtime state stored in the save and change over days, so the same item trades at different effective rates at different points. This page publishes only the static configuration baseline and never invents live rates.
两条静态规则：据点不收自己货架上已有的物品（“他们货架上就有 X，不收”），每种: Two static rules: a point refuses items already on its own shelf (“we already have X”), and gift quantities per item are capped (“we have plenty of X”).

交易价值与价格均为静态配置；游戏内成交还要经过需求加成、鉴价、谈判折扣与无人机容: Trade values and prices are static configuration; in-game deals additionally apply demand bonuses, appraisal, negotiation discounts and drone capacity. Data is read-only exported from local game configuration by codex_pages_trade.py.

默认按配置货架仍有货计算拒收。游戏里某物已不在当前可见货架上时，勾选“当前无货”: Rejection initially assumes configured shelves are stocked. If an item is absent from the current visible shelf in game, mark it absent to allow its valuation. Configured counts are not live stock.

交换用的是交易价值，不是灾前价格。完整一件基值 = TradeValue × m: Exchange uses trade value, not pre-collapse price. Full-item base value = TradeValue × max(1, configured UseTimes). Partly used items also multiply by remaining uses / instance maximum uses. Splitting a dish into servings does not add full-pot trade value.
据点：同类物资应用该据点折价系数，再应用有效 TradeSellRate；当前可: Outposts discount their own category, then apply a valid TradeSellRate, and reject identical goods still visible on their shelves. Contacts apply demand bonuses to requested goods and do not apply the outpost-only TradeSellRate. Appraisal and demand bonuses are additive.
加工增值 = 成品交出估值 − 原料直接交换估值。比较所有据点时，原料按各自最优: Added value = offered product value − direct ingredient exchange value. Across all outposts, ingredients use their best partner; for a selected partner, that partner is used. If every compared partner rejects an ingredient, its original base value is used as a conservative cost. Negotiation affects the deal only and is not counted per batch.
关系进度 NextNeed 是下一关系档的门槛，不是轮换需求，也不作为普遍估值倍: NextNeed is the next relationship-tier threshold, not rotating demand or a general valuation multiplier. Gift and supply limits are not applied to ordinary exchange. Marking an item absent only changes rejection; it does not supply received stock.
